keyFindings.description: warmUpDrain subtracts the hardcoded DefaultGrace (5 s) and drainTimeout (1 s) from the operator's stop grace, so at worker_stop_timeout_seconds ≤ 6 it is 0 and a well-behaved agent's mid-build stop leaves the lease for up to warmLeaseStale (the relaunch skips its warm-up for a minute); docs/kubernetes.md:859-863 states the containment unconditionally. At the 10 s default and ≥ 7 s the arithmetic holds and the code comment names the edge. Judged Minor: a background optimisation delayed a minute at an unusual configuration, no corruption. Fix: clamp Grace to StopGrace/2 (or make the drain deadline-based from the terminate instant) and qualify the doc sentence.

The stop-budget invariant assertion is a tautology: the left side is identically max(stopGrace, grace+drainTimeout), so it cannot fail for any input and is vacuous in exactly the ≤ 6 s configurations; assert against stopGrace alone with an explicit expectation for rows the child grace exceeds.

The heartbeat Chtimes whatever is at the lease path without the token check the release has, so a holder stalled past 60 s that resumes keeps a successor's (or a later SIGKILLed stranger's) lease fresh for the rest of its build; both preconditions predate the fix round. Hardening: re-read the token before each refresh and stop on a mismatch.
